applications.name: Ebb and Flow - Heavy
applications.description: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by 60%. Hitting the Defender with a Heavy Attack removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Cruelty Passive, increasing Critical Damage Rating by 30% for 12 second(s). When the Cruelty expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.
applications.rawDescription: The Defender has Protection, reducing all incoming damage by {0}%. Hitting the Defender with a Heavy Attack removes the Protection and grants the Attacker a Cruelty Passive, increasing Critical Damage Rating by {1}% for {2} second(s). When the Cruelty expires, the Protection returns, and all Debuffs on the Defender are Purified.
